name: Ryouri Jiman! Seido Restaurant "Kuronekotei"
original_name: 陵理自慢!性奴レストラン『黒猫亭』
source:
What makes Kuronekotei different from other restaurants is they provides sexual service other than food and drink. A girl starts working at the restaurant and have the training to be the "perfect" waitress...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028299.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
黑貓亭與其他餐廳的不同之處在於，除了食物與飲料，還提供性服務。一名女孩開始在餐廳工作，並接受成為「完美」女服務生的訓練……

（來源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028299.html]DLsite English[/url]）
